onboarding.readAlone: READ THIS ONLY WHEN YOU'RE ALONE AND HAVE TIME!!!
onboarding.welcomeText: The only thing keeping you from success and achieving your goals is a simple little ritual before going to sleep.
onboarding.dayToPrepare: And you have the whole day to prepare for it.
onboarding.notepadText: Get yourself a notepad, you know, one of those sticky ones. Write down 1-2 things you want to do tomorrow every evening before going to sleep. And do them. That's the whole trick. That's perspective.
onboarding.nameText: You'll be able to achieve anything in life, like a damn Superman. If you make plans. Starting tonight.
onboarding.smallThings:
These can be small things. Go to the hairdresser tomorrow, write a job application tomorrow, start an instrument. But these can also be big things.

What do you want to achieve in your life that was only a dream before?
onboarding.whyApp:
So why the app?

So that your dreams become tangible. I'm PAPYR, the dumbest app in the world, because I ask you to write your plans on paper. Handwritten. Every day. And sign them with your initials every day... if you want.
onboarding.exchange:
((You're trading 0.99€ct for your life's happiness!))

You give yourself goals in life, not just dreams. You give yourself a path. You see every day as a precious part of life.
onboarding.noTrick: Through discipline and structure in life: Through 1-2 things that you simply write down on a simple piece of paper. That's all there is to it. No magic trick. So why an app? It will be your photo book on the way to... wherever you want to go. This is a movement and you will be part of it. We don't need a sales pitch.
onboarding.documentPath: You're documenting your path to success here. I'm just taking the euro for the cloud. This is your file cabinet. So you can prove it to yourself. And document it to prove it to the whole world!
onboarding.alreadyStarted: This has long since started if you've made it this far! So congratulations, only one more week separates you from success! That's all. No magic. Just your commitment, digitally immortalized: Your paper, your PAPYR. Is this the dumbest idea of all time? Or is it so simple that it's genius? Find out. After you pull through for a week, I'm interested in your opinion.
onboarding.gameRules: The "Game Rules" - your path to success
onboarding.rulesPaper: Your paper: Can only be uploaded daily from 8:00 PM - 2:00 AM. If you forget, you can't document your daily success. That's the game, that's discipline.
onboarding.rulesStreak: The Streak: We count the days you stick with it. If you miss the window, you fall to 0. That's just a number. Screw it! Starting over means continuing! That's the game, that's discipline.
onboarding.rulesArchive: The File Cabinet: We store your last 14 papers for free. For €1 per month, it becomes the eternal archive of your success.
